numerical_failure.affected_api: numpy._core._internal._gcd (reached via numpy.gcd on object-dtype arrays)
numerical_failure.observed_behavior: Calling gcd on an object-dtype array containing infinity never terminates. The pure-python _gcd loop in numpy/_core/_internal.py does not finish when given infinity and zero, so the call hangs.
numerical_failure.expected_behavior: The call should terminate and raise a ValueError ('Can only find greatest common demoninator of a ...') instead of looping forever when an input is infinite.
trigger_conditions: np.gcd is applied to an object-dtype array (dtype=np.object_) containing float infinity
the other operand is an integer such as 33, or the pair is infinity and zero as passed to _gcd
_gcd is reached through the object-dtype path, which calls the pure-python _gcd function

input_output_examples.buggy_output: hang (infinite loop, the call never returns)

The Python math.gcd(float('inf'), 0) raises TypeError, and the issue suggests catching edge cases or deprecating float inputs.
